title: Join Our Email List
closedMessage: The email list sign-up is on Google Forms for now, and you can add yourself by email from the Email List page. Questions: hello@badgersupports.org.
intro: At Badger Supports, we create peer to peer spaces to talk about mental health, connect with others, and feel less alone. Whether you're in a group, workshop, or craft night, you're part of a community that gets it.
Join our email list to stay up-to-date on our latest updates, events, and more!
review: Built closed (decision 3.1), from Google's public view of 23 Oct 2026; the Email List page still links the Google Form. Words are Google's, with these changes. Google's form is one page. 'Your Email' is our section title; 'Add Yourself (Optional)' is Google's 'Add Yourself (OPTIONAL)' in the page's Title Case. Google's four numbered steps stay numbered; its first, 'CLICK HERE to send an email to …', reads as the Email List page's does ('Send an email to …'), with the address as a link below the steps, and Google's bold and asterisks on 'Do not use the option…' are dropped. 'All set! Click submit!' is dropped: the button says Send. The confirmation is ours. It says the request is received and the person is not on the list yet, because the site knows only that: whether they are invited, pending or subscribed is known to the Google Group, and to Connect once someone records it (WORK.md item 12). How a request reaches the group today is the owner's step 7. No receipt: the site never emails an address no one has confirmed.

questions.label: Email
questions.help: Add your email below to join our mailing list. Badger Supports sends out updates about every two weeks.
questions.review: Google's is a short-answer box marked Email; this one checks the address is an email address. The help is Google's.

list: Within a minute or two, you’ll receive an email to confirm your membership.
To complete your subscription to the email list, reply to the email you received and send a blank email. Do not use the option of clicking the ‘Join This Group’ button.
You will receive a confirmation email once you have replied to the email and have joined the group.

confirmation.title: Request Received
body: Thank you. We have your request to join the Badger Supports email list.
You are not on the list yet. You will hear from Google Groups when you are.
To join straight away, send an email to badgersupports+subscribe@g-groups.wisc.edu and reply to the email you receive.

source.read: Public respondent view, 23 Oct 2026, read for its questions only. Settings, destination sheet, scripts and responses not opened. Google's form name begins EXEC, so the owner is Executive; Connect keeps only the leaders' newsletter list today, so the queue is a proposal.
